sourceDataStatus: Reconciled with the current 22-god creator compendium; all deity-to-people relationships follow the official order.

deities.name: Nebyrr
deities.domainsText: Civilization, lineage, dynasties, marriage, inheritance, social order
deities.createdPeoplesDoctrine: Nebyrr is the sole creator-god assigned to Humans, Near-Humans, and Mixed Heritage: Human, Half-Elf (choose an Elven-Type), Half-Orc (Human + Orc ancestry), Khoravar Half-Elf (choose an Elven-Type), and Umbral Human. Human retains its five established lineage options. Half-Elf and Khoravar Half-Elf each choose one of 21 Elven-Type ancestries: the 15 Elf bloodlines or one of the six Kaluseban bloodlines.

deities.name: Sigrananna
deities.domainsText: Forests, moonlight, wilderness, hunters, elven beauty
deities.createdPeoplesDoctrine: Sigrananna is the sole creator-god assigned to Elven-Types: Elf and Kaluseban. Elf and Kaluseban are separate parent races. Elf has 15 established bloodlines; Kaluseban has six bundled custom bloodlines that are never treated as Elf bloodlines.

deities.name: Marduthor
deities.domainsText: Invention, craft, metalwork, architecture, subterranean halls
deities.createdPeoplesDoctrine: Marduthor is the sole creator-god assigned to Dwarven and Gnomish Kin: Dwarf, Gnome, and Deep Gnome. Dwarf retains Duergar as its established bloodline.

deities.name: Ishtanora
deities.domainsText: Hearths, harvests, villages, fertility, rural peace
deities.createdPeoplesDoctrine: Ishtanora is the sole creator-god assigned to Halfling and Smallfolk: Halfling, Kender, Kithkin, Qickstep, Hedge, and Jerbeen. No additional canonical bloodline, lineage, or non-bloodline form menu is assigned to this category.

deities.name: Enkirael
deities.domainsText: Conquest, fury, survival, dominance, warfare
deities.createdPeoplesDoctrine: Enkirael is the sole creator-god assigned to Orcs, Goblins, and Goblinoid Kin: Orc, Goblin, Hobgoblin, Bugbear, Gobboc, Shadow Goblin, Boggart, and Verdan. No additional canonical bloodline, lineage, or non-bloodline form menu is assigned to this category.

deities.name: Anubaldir
deities.domainsText: Endurance, burden, strength, resilience
deities.createdPeoplesDoctrine: Anubaldir is the sole creator-god assigned to Giantkin and Powerful Humanoids: Goliath, Firbolg, and Cyclopian. No additional canonical bloodline, lineage, or non-bloodline form menu is assigned to this category.

deities.name: Valkhamesh
deities.domainsText: Draconic bloodlines, sovereignty, storms, ancient dominion
deities.createdPeoplesDoctrine: Valkhamesh is the sole creator-god assigned to Draconic and Reptilian Races: Dragonborn, Kobold, Lizardfolk, Yuan-Ti, and Tortle. Dragonborn retains nine project-specific bloodlines.

deities.name: Freyseth
deities.domainsText: Crossroads, curses, planar bloodlines, temptation, forbidden pacts
deities.createdPeoplesDoctrine: Freyseth is the sole creator-god assigned to Celestial, Fiendish, and Planar Peoples: Aasimar, Tiefling, Hexblood, Accursed, and Curseborn. Tiefling retains Feral as its established bloodline.

deities.name: Nefarokir
deities.domainsText: Death, spirits, memory, burial, forgotten dead, underworld
deities.createdPeoplesDoctrine: Nefarokir is the sole creator-god assigned to Undead and Death-Touched Races: Dhampir, Darakhul, Reborn, Arisen, Graveborn, Shade, and Downcast. No additional canonical bloodline, lineage, or non-bloodline form menu is assigned to this category.

deities.name: Thalunesh
deities.domainsText: Dreams, tricksters, shapeshifting, wanderers, fey mischief
deities.createdPeoplesDoctrine: Thalunesh is the sole creator-god assigned to Fey-Folk: Faerie, Fairy, Gandirosha, Changeling, Lorwyn Changeling, Satyr, and Dreamer. No additional canonical bloodline, lineage, or non-bloodline form menu is assigned to this category.

deities.name: Horundar
deities.domainsText: Storms, oceans, floods, earthquakes, elemental force
deities.createdPeoplesDoctrine: Horundar is the sole creator-god assigned to Elemental and Energy-Born Peoples: Genasi, Elemental Kin, Elementborn, and Panolima. Genasi has four bloodlines, Elemental Kin has two, Elementborn has six, and Panolima has five bundled custom bloodlines.

deities.name: Raeshkul
deities.domainsText: Intellect, psionics, strategy, higher understanding
deities.createdPeoplesDoctrine: Raeshkul is the sole creator-god assigned to Psionic, Astral, and Alien Minds: Kalashtar, Githyanki, Githzerai, Disembodied, and Gwynis. No additional canonical bloodline, lineage, or non-bloodline form menu is assigned to this category.

deities.name: Setrimir
deities.domainsText: Artificial life, constructs, stolen knowledge, awakened machinery
deities.createdPeoplesDoctrine: Setrimir is the sole creator-god assigned to Constructed and Artificial Beings: Warforged, Geppettin, Relicborn, Wechselkind, and Autognome. No additional canonical bloodline, lineage, or non-bloodline form menu is assigned to this category.

deities.name: Sokhivar
deities.domainsText: Sunlight, music, prophecy, divine freedom, sky
deities.createdPeoplesDoctrine: Sokhivar is the sole creator-god assigned to Birdfolk and Avian Races: Aarakocra, Kenku, Owlin, Ravenfolk, Corvum, Gallus, Strig, Feathren, Raptor, and Luma. No additional canonical bloodline, lineage, or non-bloodline form menu is assigned to this category.

deities.name: Iskareth
deities.domainsText: Instinct, beasts, fertility, natural kinship
deities.createdPeoplesDoctrine: Iskareth is the sole creator-god assigned to Animalfolk and Mammalian Anthropomorphs: Harengon, Leonin, Loxodon, Tabaxi, Bearfolk, Canisar, Cervan, Erina, Mapach, Ratatosk, Rakin, Sattare, Vulpin, Geisamahi, Hadozee, Giff, Gnoll, Shifter, Centaur, and Minotaur. No additional canonical bloodline, lineage, or non-bloodline form menu is assigned to this category.

deities.name: Bastveig
deities.domainsText: Tides, reefs, trenches, hidden waters, ocean civilizations
deities.createdPeoplesDoctrine: Bastveig is the sole creator-god assigned to Amphibious and Aquatic Peoples: Triton, Locathah, Grung, Merfolk, Sahuagin, Lotol, Nakudama, Dril'thar, and Tamhiogal. Dril'thar has six canonical bloodlines—Grassland, Lush Forest, Marsh, Rainforest, Ocean, and Reef—and every Dril'thar bloodline can breathe underwater.

deities.name: Thoryn-Rahek
deities.domainsText: Aberrant life, mutation, insectoid horrors, oozes
deities.createdPeoplesDoctrine: Thoryn-Rahek is the sole creator-god assigned to Insectoid, Ooze, and Aberrant Creatures: Thri-Kreen, Cnidarin, Oozekin, Opteran, Silkborn, and Plasmoid. No additional canonical bloodline, lineage, or non-bloodline form menu is assigned to this category.

deities.name: Hathruna
deities.domainsText: Rebirth, rot, fungi, roots, seasonal cycles
deities.createdPeoplesDoctrine: Hathruna is the sole creator-god assigned to Plantfolk and Nature-Bound Races: Mandrake, Mycelian, Gnarlborn, and Harvestborn. No additional canonical bloodline, lineage, or non-bloodline form menu is assigned to this category.

deities.name: Eirzunet
deities.domainsText: Shadows, curses, twilight transformation, forbidden magic
deities.createdPeoplesDoctrine: Eirzunet is the sole creator-god assigned to Shadow, Umbral, and Darkness-Aligned Peoples: Ombrask, Ruinbound, Blagueborn, and Threadborn. No additional canonical bloodline, lineage, or non-bloodline form menu is assigned to this category.

deities.name: Oskar'enlil
deities.domainsText: Adaptation, civilization, instinct, engineered races
deities.createdPeoplesDoctrine: Oskar'enlil is the sole creator-god assigned to Experimental and Bio-Engineered Races: Simic Hybrid. No additional canonical bloodline, lineage, or non-bloodline form menu is assigned to this category.

deities.name: Asethyr
deities.domainsText: Freedom, revelry, tribal rites, wilderness survival
deities.createdPeoplesDoctrine: Asethyr is the sole creator-god assigned to Primitive, Tribal, and Wilderness Humanoids: Grudgel, Hederan, Laneshi, and Terandus. No additional canonical bloodline, lineage, or non-bloodline form menu is assigned to this category.

deities.name: Nephthysra
deities.domainsText: Beauty, charisma, emotional influence, uniqueness
deities.createdPeoplesDoctrine: Nephthysra is the sole creator-god assigned to Miscellaneous and Hard-to-Classify Races: Dara, Golynn, Jaspey, Aburata, Vedalken, Volsarii, and Deorbasun. Jaspey has three non-bloodline forms—Mosscap, Gloomtail, and Rotcap. Deorbasun uses an open soul-animal bloodline established by the first true soul bond.

canonicalRevision.spatialAuthority: Final 2048 x 1024 equirectangular anchors and province transforms from the corrected geological/weather compendium override every earlier coordinate, UTC, mapped-biome/depth, and route geometry value.
canonicalRevision.nonSpatialAuthority: Current pantheon/races and life compendia preserve and extend non-spatial canon; the newest night-sky/time compendium governs calendar, celestial, and exact settlement UTC data.
